artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.description: The image shows five individuals surrounding a large draped figure near the entrance of a dark cave-like space. They have middle-aged features, styled hair, and wear robe-like garments. The background features a rocky surface with sparse vegetation. A monogram in the corner reads "ISP."

artworks.title: The Good Shepherd
artworks.description: The image shows a person walking and holding a lamb over their shoulders. The person is depicted in profile, with their head slightly bowed and hands clasped in front. The figure has delicate facial features, a beard, and shoulder-length hair. They are wearing a long robe with loose sleeves. A crown of thorns is on their head, from which rays of light emanate, forming a halo effect. The background features a pastoral landscape with rolling hills, some foliage, and a distant crucifix on a hilltop.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman at Market
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a slight profile, facing to the left. They are wearing a hooded garment that covers their head and drapes down to their ankles, revealing the lower part of the forearms. The facial features are not distinctly detailed. The individual is holding a pole or staff-like object in one hand and a few stalks of garlic or onions in the other hand. In the background, there is a basket on the ground with circular objects and a barrel with more garlic or onions. Beside them, a large jug with a spout is visible. A banner with text curls through the image.

artworks.title: Medal of King Ferdinand of Hungary and Bohemia
artworks.description: The image depicts a profile view of a person from the waist up within a circular frame. The person is facing to the right, holding a staff with an ornate top in their right hand and another elongated object in their left hand. They wear a crown and armor with intricate detailing. The background transitions from light to dark around the circular frame. Outside the frame, there are the letters "HSP" on a textured surface.

artworks.title: Adam Seated
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated, muscular, nude male figure holding an apple, positioned atop a tree stump with a large tree trunk in the background. In the scene, there is a pastoral landscape with plants and a castle or estate with turrets visible behind the figure. The drawing is detailed, featuring fine anatomical details in the figure and intricate foliage and background elements. The artwork suggests a focus on natural and human form typical of renascent art.

artworks.title: Achilles and Hector
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient battle scene. The artwork features a combat between armored warriors riding on horseback. The figures are engaged in battle, with the horses rearing up. Shields and spears are displayed, emphasizing the martial theme. The detailing of the musculature of the horses and warriors adds to the tension. The drawing style is characterized by bold lines that create contrast. The names "Achiles" and "Hector" are inscribed above two figures.

artworks.title: Adam Standing
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure standing in a contrapposto position. He has curly hair and defined features. The figure is nude and holds an apple in his right hand and a staff in his left hand. Beside him lies a cow's head and body among plants. The background features detailed foliage and a cascading shape. The artwork is monochrome with engraved lines for texture and depth, and inscriptions are in the top right corner.

artworks.title: Eve Standing
artworks.description: This print depicts a nude woman standing upright. She is in the center of the print, her body facing us and her head turned to the left, with her left hand holding an apple to her chest and her right hand holding a large snake that coils between her legs and around her ankles. She has pale skin and long, wavy hair that cascades down her left shoulder. In the top left corner is a leafy tree with more apples hanging from it. Behind her feet is a large lion, its head and paws near the lower right corner. The background is mostly made of dark crosshatched lines, with a patch of sky visible near the bottom left corner, showing more trees and a path leading away. Inscriptions, including the date “1523, can be seen in the upper right corner. The background of the print is beige paper."

artworks.title: Expulsion from Paradise
artworks.description: The artwork depicts three human figures shown in full, with their entire bodies visible. The two figures on the left, both male, are positioned with one facing left, raising his arm over his head, and the other facing slightly right, holding an apple in his hand. The male figures' hair is short and combed back, with distinct muscular features evident in their bodies. The figure on the right, a female, stands facing inward away from the males, with long, flowing hair cascading down her back. All three individuals appear nude. Surrounding them are stylized clouds. In the lower foreground, a cherubic face emerges from the clouds. The background consists primarily of swirling clouds.

artworks.title: Lot and His Daughters
artworks.description: The etching features three people in a compact composition. Two figures are at the front, with the third slightly behind them. The figure in the foreground wears a cap and a long-sleeved tunic, bending forward holding a jug and a cup. The figure next to them is seated and turned slightly towards the first figure. A third figure, partially obscured, looks on from the background. Additional details include a jug at their feet and a plant behind them. The background is marked with dark crosshatch lines within a circular frame.

artworks.title: Judith and Her Servant Standing
artworks.description: The image shows two full-bodied figures standing close together, both facing forward. The figure on the left is a woman, depicted nude, with her head slightly tilted towards the figure beside her. She has distinct, classical facial features and wavy hair adorned with a thin band or headband. Her right arm is bent, holding a large sword with ornate details, and her left arm is draped around the shoulders of the person next to her. The second figure, also nude and of similar stature, holds a severed human head by its hair in their left hand, with a platter in their right hand. Their hair is styled similarly to the first figure, with an accessory resembling a headband. The background features a textured, hatched pattern, providing a contrast to the figures and giving the impression of shadowing behind them. Both figures are barefoot and stand on a lightly shaded ground.

artworks.title: Judith Walking to the Left, and Her Servant
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures engaged in an intimate interaction. The drawing depicts a scene with two standing figures, one clothed and holding a large sword with ornate detailing, and the other partially nude with flowing hair and a wreath adorning their head. The clothed figure holds an object resembling a ball and is draped in fabric. The nude figure appears to be in motion, with their limbs positioned gracefully and flowing hair. The use of detailed line work and shading brings texture and dimensionality to the figures.

artworks.title: Judith Seated in an Arch
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.5 x 5 cm (2 15/16 x 1 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a nude woman seated with her upper body turned slightly to the side. Her head is bowed, showcasing intricately braided hair, and she holds a sword in one hand while the other rests on a severed head. She is minimally clothed with draped fabric over her legs. In the background is an archway revealing trees, buildings, and a fence, creating a pastoral setting. The focal points are her expression and the objects she holds.

artworks.title: Joseph and Potiphar's Wife
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures in a room. On the left is a woman seated and leaning slightly forward with her head turned to the right. She has curly hair with a headband or crown and wears a bracelet on her right wrist. The figure on the right is a male standing, with his left arm outstretched. His hair is short and wavy, and he appears muscular. The background shows draped fabric, a bed or bench with ornate details and tassels, as well as architectural elements like pillars and a border inscribed with Latin text.

artworks.title: Job Conversing with His Friends
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures and an angel in a classical scene. The artwork depicts four seated figures engaged in a serious conversation, each displaying expressive gestures and facial expressions. They are clad in period clothing and are positioned under a tree. To the left, a sack rests on the ground. Central in the scene is a standing woman gesturing with her hands, while an angelic figure hovers above her in the sky. The backdrop displays ancient architecture with the details of stone bricks and arches creating depth.

artworks.title: The Virgin, Holding a Pear, with the Child
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated outdoors, cradling an infant in her arms. The woman has closed eyes and long, wavy hair with a headpiece, wearing a layered gown with fur trim, and a belt. The infant has curly hair and reaches out, being supported by the woman. There is a tree trunk in the background, grass in the bottom right corner, and a tattered cloth covering the woman's legs with a few stones and an inscription at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child with a Parrot
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting with a child standing next to them. The person has distinct facial features, long hair, and wears flowing clothing with voluminous sleeves. The child has curly hair and holds a bird in their hand. The person holds an apple close to the child. In the background, there is a tree with bare branches and a castle or large building labeled "S. MARIA."

artworks.title: The Wedding at Cana
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group dining scene. The drawing features several figures seated around a table that is laden with dishes. The architecture of the room shows arched windows that open to a view with trees, through which light streams in. A bird perches on the sill of one of these windows. The composition is densely packed with intricate details, including the varied postures and gestures of the people in the scene. The style reflects techniques used in early European printmaking.

artworks.title: Christ and the Woman of Samaria
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a well or water source. The detailed engraving captures a scene where an individual with a vessel or jug is reaching towards an elderly, bearded figure who is seated by the well. Several other figures are positioned around them, each showing expressions of interest or conversation. The scene features a pulley system at the well and various other containers, with rolling hills and a distant cityscape in the backdrop. The overall composition appears to convey a narrative moment.

artworks.title: Christ at the Table of Simon the Pharisee
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people seated around a table with various objects and food on display. The scene features six figures gathered around a circular table, which is adorned with a large platter containing a bird, a goblet, and a jug. The figures are dressed in richly detailed garments and they appear to be engaged in conversation. The background shows a landscape view through two arched windows, with a shelf of books and a large jug in the room. The artwork features intricate linework and shading reminiscent of engravings or etchings from the 16th century.

artworks.title: Christ as Man of Sorrows at the Foot of the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man holding a chalice and a piece of bread in each hand. The figure is positioned in front of a ladder and a tree. The man has a crown of thorns, a halo-like glow around his head, a beard, long hair, and is barefoot. His body is wrapped with a cloth, and he is standing on rocky ground with scattered stones. The background has a pattern of dense, crosshatched lines. In the lower-right corner, there is a tablet with the date "1520" and the initials "ISP."

artworks.title: Head of Christ
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a close-up of an individual's face, displaying from the top of their head to the chin. The person is positioned facing forward and is wearing a crown of thorns on their head. Their facial features include a somber expression with downward-cast eyes, a long, flowing beard, and shoulder-length hair that is slightly wavy. The engraving style emphasizes the texture of the hair and the crown of thorns. The person is not shown wearing any visible clothing or jewelry, nor holding any objects. The background of the image consists of fine lines and shading that suggests a neutral backdrop. At the bottom of the image, there is an inscription that reads "ISP 1520."

artworks.title: Head of Christ
artworks.description: The image is a close-up portrait showing only the head and shoulders of a man. The man is facing slightly to the right, with his eyes looking upwards. He has a full beard and mustache, with curly hair partially covering his forehead. On his head, he wears a crown made of twisted, thorny branches. The background is simple and unadorned. There is a date, "1520," and a monogram in the top left corner.

artworks.title: Christ on the Globe
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length figure standing on a small sphere in a dynamic pose. The person has a bearded face, long hair, and is holding a staff with a cross and banner. They wear a draped garment and are surrounded by cherubic faces and wings against a cloud-filled background. Above them, a dove radiates light. The scene is enclosed within an oval design with inscriptions along the inner edges.
